lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Pay up, you wretch. The fare.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Shout away, Charon, if it makes you feel better.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Pay up, I said. For ferrying you across.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: You can't get it from someone who hasn't got it.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Is there anyone who doesn't have an obol?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: I don't know about anyone else. I don't have one.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: By Pluto, I'll throttle you, you filthy little — if you don't pay.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: And I'll crack your skull open with that pole of yours.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Then you'll have made the whole crossing for nothing.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Let Hermes pay you on my behalf. He's the one who handed me over.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Oh, wonderful. [sighs] By Zeus, I'm really getting my money's worth, if I have to start covering the dead as well.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: I am not letting this go.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Well, in that case, haul your boat up on the beach and sit down — you're going to be here a while. Since I haven't got it, how exactly are you planning to take it?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: You didn't know you were supposed to bring it?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: I knew. I just didn't have it. What of it? Was I supposed to skip dying on that account?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: So you'll be the one man who can boast he sailed across for free?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Not free, my good man. I bailed. I took a turn at the oar. And I was the only passenger who wasn't blubbering.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: None of that means anything to a ferryman. You owe the obol. That's the rule. It cannot be otherwise.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Well then, take me back to the land of the living.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: [flat] Charming. So I can get a beating from Aeacus on top of everything else.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Then stop bothering me.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Show me what you've got in that satchel.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Lupin beans, if you'd like. And some of Hecate's supper.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Hermes — where did you find this dog and bring him to us? The way he kept chattering the whole voyage, jeering at the other passengers, mocking them, singing — singing! — while they were all wailing.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: You don't know who you just ferried, Charon? A genuinely free man. Nothing matters to him. That's Menippus.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Well, if I ever catch you again —

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: If you catch me, my good man. [pause] But you won't catch me twice.
